engagement_background.objective: Reduce procurement costs across indirect categories while supporting APDerm’s rapid multi-site growth.
engagement_background.scope_summary: Phase 1 focused on Employee Benefits, Medical Supplies, IT Hardware, Telecom, Courier, Office Supplies, Small Parcel; later phases added eight additional categories (billing system, janitorial, etc.).
constraints_challenges: Pandemic-related inflation and supply chain disruption
Need to maintain clinical quality and avoid operational disruption

procurement_environment.data_availability: Fragmented AP data; limited SKU-level visibility pre-project.
procurement_environment.data_quality_notes: Spend baselines in Agreement were ‘estimations based on AP data’.

summary.headline: $1.2 M run-rate savings across 10+ categories
summary.narrative: Over two sourcing phases Treya Partners delivered $1.2 million (19 %) annual savings on $6.3 million of baseline spend for APDerm.  Savings were achieved largely with incumbent vendors, minimizing disruption while capturing more than $12 million in enterprise value.

annual_savings.notes: Case study states ‘Total project savings of $1.2M or 19%’

impact.operational_improvements: Majority of spend remained with incumbents; limited operational change required.

proof_points.statement: 19 % savings on $6.3 M baseline within six months

evidence.quote: The Treya/AP Derm strategic sourcing project created $1.2M or 19% in cost savings on an addressable baseline of $6.3M.

baseline_spend.notes: Total baseline spend referenced in case study.

categories.notes: Detailed category-level outcomes not disclosed in final case study; see Extraction Notes.

case_study_packaging.headline: $1.2 M savings (19 %) across indirect spend for PE-backed dermatology platform
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Rapidly expanding dermatology network lacked centralized procurement, driving fragmented spend and rising costs.
approach_summary: Two-phase strategic sourcing program addressing >10 indirect categories.
Combined RFPs, GPO leverage, and incumbent renegotiations for quick wins.
Maintained clinical quality while consolidating vendor base.
Implemented savings and tracked results with APDerm stakeholders.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya unlocked 19 % savings and $12 M+ in enterprise value, funding continued practice growth with minimal disruption.
where_we_were_unique: Hybrid strategy of GPO quick wins plus deep category RFPs
Hands-on support minimizing client resource burden
PE-savvy reporting and savings tracking for board visibility
